---
title: "Released version 1.3.0 of the rkTeaching package"
description: "The 1.3.0 version of the R package rkTeaching is available to install."
date: 2016-05-30
categories: [R, rkTeaching]
image: featured.png
---

Version 1.3.0 of [rkTeaching](https://github.com/asalber/rkteaching), the R
package for learning Statistics, is now available. It's updated to work with
R 3.2.3 and RKWard 0.6.5 — a transitional release ahead of a major update
that will bring internationalization to the package.
